# discord_channel_permission (Resource)

Manages a Discord channel permission overwrite for a role or member.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) The ID of the channel to apply the permission overwrite to.
- `overwrite_id` (String) The ID of the role or member to apply the permission overwrite for.
- `type` (String) The type of overwrite: `role` or `member`.

### Optional

- `allow` (Number) The bitwise value of allowed permissions.
- `deny` (Number) The bitwise value of denied permissions.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the format `channel_id:overwrite_id`.
